purpose: Choose the next SNOOZE content-production route after rejecting paid-cloud-as-core and song-prior local music models.

benchmarkOnly.name: Gemini reference output
benchmarkOnly.reason: User-approved relaxation target, but using the paid provider as the product core would remove SNOOZE differentiation.

benchmarkOnly.name: Stability Audio API
benchmarkOnly.reason: Commercial cloud API can compare quality, but must not become the default paid-product production route.

candidates.name: AudioCraft / MusicGen / MusicGen-Style
evidence: Local reference-conditioned tests still produced busy, hurried, chaotic, and rock-like musical priors.
candidates.decision: Research evidence only; do not use for commercial SNOOZE assets.

candidates.name: AudioLDM2
candidates.decision: Research reference only; non-commercial/share-alike terms conflict with paid SNOOZE assets.

candidates.name: Tango / TangoFlux
evidence: .local-models/TangoFlux/LICENSE.md says non-commercial, research-only and references dataset restrictions.
candidates.decision: Research reference only; do not use for commercial SNOOZE assets.

candidates.name: ACE-Step
evidence: User listening tests rejected repeated batches as bar/lounge/excited/strong melody and not sleep, meditation, or focus.
candidates.decision: Do not run more SNOOZE sleep/calm/focus batches from ACE-Step unless explicitly doing model-comparison research.

candidates.name: Stable Audio Open / stable-audio-tools self-hosted
evidence: Hugging Face API reports stabilityai/stable-audio-open-1.0 and stable-audio-open-small as gated with license:other.
Unauthenticated README/LICENSE fetch returns 401 restricted access.
candidates.decision: Next external-model candidate only after authenticated terms are reviewed and confirmed commercial-compatible.

candidates.name: SNOOZE controlled stem factory
evidence: Avoids full-song priors by producing dry sparse components: soft keys, warm support tones, room textures, tiny accents.
Lets Recipe V2 own duration, arrangement, fades, loop behavior, loudness, and foreground/background balance.
candidates.decision: Use as the immediate next implementation route while external self-hosted model terms are unresolved.

activeNextRoute.name: SNOOZE controlled stem factory
activeNextRoute.deliverable: A review page with dry sparse musical stems and simple Recipe V2 combinations, not a full AI song batch.
acceptance: No buzzing/mechanical drone as the main sound.
No bar, jazz, lounge, rock, celebratory, cinematic, or rapper/pop prior.
Noise and environment remain below attention, normally under 10 percent perceptual prominence.
Music bed stays sparse, low-energy, non-climactic, and replayable.
